body: e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs probe_equipment_scaling: `concentration_tolerance` is set to 0.55 (55%), meaning the 2× tank can have concentrations 55% divergent from the 1× tank and still pass. The actual divergence is ~32% for peak TAN and ~39% for DO range. The acceptance criteria state 'per-liter concentrations and qualitative outcomes stay within envelope across both sizes' — 55% tolerance is very permissive for a scaling-equivalence test. Consider whether a tighter tolerance (e.g., 35-40%) would better validate the scaling invariant while still accommodating legitimate non-linear effects.
